items.title: 特斯拉連三紅 市場淡化美國安全調查影響
items.title_en: Tesla Racks Up Third Consecutive Rally as Market Downplays US Safety Probe Impact
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，特斯拉 (Tesla)(TSLA-US) 股價周一 (3 日) 上漲，連續第三個交易日收高，擺脫公司公布第二季財報後的一波跌勢。即使美國國家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 針對一項安全問題展開調查，投資人似乎並未過於擔憂。
這家電動車製造商股價上漲 3.5%，收在 322.08 美元。標普 500 指數與道瓊工業平均指數當日分別上漲 1.5% 及 1.3%。
這也是特斯拉股價連續第三個交易日上漲。就在上周，特斯拉股價一年多來首度跌破 300 美元。自 7 月 22 日公布遜於市場預期的第二季財報後，特斯拉股價曾連跌六個交易日，累計跌幅超過 20%。
由執行長馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 執掌的特斯拉，第二季營業利益約 4 億美元，比華爾街原先預估少了約 13 億美元。
此外，公司管理層也未向投資人提供太多有關 AI 發展計畫的新資訊，包括備受關注的自動駕駛計程車 Robotaxi 與機器人。
如今相較於核心電動車業務，市場更加關注特斯拉的 AI 發展進度，而周一的股價表現再次印證了這點。NHTSA 近日已針對超過 100 萬輛特斯拉電動車展開調查，並指出前懸吊系統的部分零件可能脫落，導致潛在的危險行車狀況。
過去這類調查消息可能會引發特斯拉股價短暫下跌。但在美國汽車產業中，安全調查與召回本就是日常營運的一部分。通常 NHTSA 會先展開調查，再視情況決定是否要求車廠發布召回，以修正潛在的安全問題。
美國每年都有數十家車廠、數百萬輛車因各種原因遭到召回，這是維護車輛安全的正常程序。因此召回事件很少對股價造成明顯影響，對汽車產業投資人而言，通常只是需要持續關注的事項，而非足以改變投資判斷的重大事件。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that Tesla (TSLA-US) shares rose on Monday (the 3rd), marking a third straight trading day of gains and shaking off a slump that followed the company’s Q2 earnings release. Even though the U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) has opened an investigation into a safety issue, investors do not appear overly worried.
The electric‑vehicle maker’s stock jumped 3.5% to close at $322.08. The S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 1.5% and 1.3% respectively on the day.

This is Tesla’s third consecutive trading‑day gain. Just last week the stock fell below $300 for the first time in more than a year. Since reporting a Q2 earnings beat that missed market expectations on July 22, Tesla’s shares had slid for six straight sessions, shedding more than 20% in total.
Led by CEO Elon Musk, Tesla posted Q2 operating profit of about $400 million, roughly $1.3 billion below Wall Street forecasts.
In addition, management gave investors little new information on its AI development plans, including the highly watched Robotaxi autonomous‑taxi service and robotics projects.

Compared with its core EV business, the market is now more focused on Tesla’s AI progress, and Monday’s price action reaffirmed that view. NHTSA recently launched a probe covering over one million Tesla vehicles, flagging that certain front‑suspension components could detach, creating a potential hazardous driving condition.

In the past, such investigation news sometimes triggered a brief dip in Tesla’s share price. However, safety investigations and recalls are routine in the U.S. auto industry. Typically NHTSA opens an inquiry first and then decides whether a recall is required to address any safety concerns.

Each year dozens of automakers and millions of vehicles in the United States are recalled for various reasons – a normal part of maintaining vehicle safety. Consequently, recall events rarely have a material impact on stock prices; for auto‑industry investors they are generally a matter of ongoing monitoring rather than a decisive factor in investment decisions.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元持平 美日聯手干預日元與油價回落削弱通膨憂慮
items.title_en: New York FX: Dollar Flat as US‑Japan Joint Yen Intervention and Falling Oil Prices Ease Inflation Concerns
paras: 美元周一 (3 日) 變動不大，市場持續消化聯準會 (Fed) 最新的貨幣政策決議、美日兩國證實聯手干預日元匯市，以及地緣政治緊張局勢降溫帶動油價下跌、進一步緩解近期的通膨疑慮。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數 (DXY) 持平於 99.90。
上周在聯準會宣布維持利率不變、並對未來貨幣政策路徑釋出不明朗訊號後，美元指數已下跌 1.5%。
受到美日兩國確認聯手干預日元匯市影響，美元兌日元承壓，下跌 0.3% 至 157.18，盤中一度跌至 155.23。
歐元兌美元下跌 0.2%，至 1 歐元兌 1.1508 美元。
市場同時關注油價走低，這有助於降低短期通膨壓力。這項趨勢也受到美國總統川普周末宣布的消息支持──美國將於今日與伊朗就荷姆茲海峽 (Strait of Hormuz) 航運及去核化議題展開談判，顯示中東局勢明顯降溫。
美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 周日表示，美國堅定支持日本採取措施，糾正日元遭嚴重低估的情況，並明確警告，美國財政部將毫不猶豫參與未來任何進一步的聯合市場干預行動。
此次干預是數十年來美日首次聯手買進日元。在 7 月底日元兌美元一度跌破 162、創下 40 年新低後，兩國決定進場干預。
這次干預也為日元波動劇烈的 7 月畫下句點。最終日元 7 月兌美元升值 1.6%，創下去年 10 月以來最佳單月表現。市場干預，加上日本銀行 (BoJ) 釋出的鷹派訊號，引發大量空頭部位回補，推升日元走強。
市場也消化了日本銀行上周五公布的貨幣政策決議。日銀如市場預期，將基準利率維持在 1.0% 不變。
不過，日銀總裁植田和男 (Kazuo Ueda) 仍維持偏鷹立場。他警告，高能源進口成本可能推升通膨風險，並暗示央行仍準備在今年稍晚進一步升息。
整體外匯市場走勢，仍受到中東局勢發展影響。美國總統川普宣布，美國與伊朗官員將於周一恢復直接談判。
美國銀行全球研究部策略師指出，儘管市場因日本資金持續外流，以及高市早苗 (Sanae Takaichi) 政府政策風險等因素，對日元仍普遍抱持悲觀看法，但此次美日聯合干預具重大轉折意義。
美銀認為，美元兌日元 155 價位可能成為外匯市場的重要「轉折點」。策略師指出，今年稍早數次官方干預期間，美元兌日元都能在 155 附近獲得強力支撐，因此市場普遍認為官方干預效果有限。
然而，一旦匯價明確跌破 155，市場交易模式可能從「逢低買進美元」轉變為「反彈賣出美元」，企業避險需求所帶來的美元賣壓，也可能進一步加速此轉變。
美銀證券外匯與利率策略師 Shusuke Yamada 表示，「美國加入協同干預，提升市場對更廣泛政策架構的期待，目標是穩定日元匯率。」
他進一步補充，「由於美國參與，單方面耗盡外匯存底的限制實際上已經消除，因此投機資金要與官方對抗將變得更加困難。」
為降低出售美元可能對美國公債市場造成的影響，日本財務大臣與美國財長貝森特皆表示，將運用聯準會的「外國及國際貨幣當局附買回融資機制 (Foreign and International Monetary Authorities, FIMA)」提供流動性支援。
美銀也指出，此次聯合干預提高了市場對日銀加快升息步伐的預期，原本市場預估 10 月升息 1 碼，如今可能提前至 9 月實施。
另一方面，川普證實已取消原先規劃的軍事打擊行動，改以外交談判方式推動重新開放荷姆茲海峽，國際原油價格暴跌逾 4%，全球市場對能源推升通膨的短期憂慮也因此明顯降溫。
隨著地緣政治風險溢價略為消退，外匯市場接下來將把焦點轉向本周即將公布的一系列美國重要經濟數據，以研判聯準會 9 月的利率政策方向。其中最受關注的是一連串勞動市場數據，並將以 7 月非農就業報告作為壓軸焦點。

paras_en: The U.S. dollar changed little on Monday (the 3rd) as markets continued to digest the Fed’s latest monetary‑policy decision, the confirmed joint intervention by the United States and Japan in the yen market, and the cooling of geopolitical tensions that pushed oil prices lower and further eased recent inflation worries.
In the late New York session, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, held steady at 99.90.
After the Fed announced it would keep rates unchanged last week and offered an ambiguous outlook for future policy, the dollar index had already fallen 1.5%.
Following the confirmation that the United States and Japan were coordinating a yen‑market intervention, the dollar fell 0.3% against the yen to 157.18, briefly dipping to 155.23 intraday.
The euro slipped 0.2% against the dollar to $1.1508 per euro.

Markets also focused on the decline in oil prices, which helps reduce short‑term inflation pressure. This trend was reinforced by a weekend announcement from U.S. President Trump that the United States would begin talks with Iran on Strait of Hormuz shipping and denuclearisation, signalling a clear de‑escalation in the Middle East.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Sunday that the United States firmly supports Japan’s measures to correct the yen’s severe undervaluation and warned that the Treasury would not hesitate to join any further joint market‑intervention actions.

The intervention marks the first U.S.–Japan coordinated yen‑buying operation in decades. After the yen fell below 162 per dollar at the end of July – a 40‑year low – the two countries decided to step in.

The move also capped the volatile July for the yen. By the end of the month the yen had appreciated 1.6% against the dollar, its best monthly performance since October last year. Market intervention, together with hawkish signals from the Bank of Japan (BoJ), triggered a large short‑covering rally that pushed the yen higher.
Markets also absorbed the BoJ’s policy decision released last Friday. As expected, the central bank left its benchmark rate unchanged at 1.0%.

However, BoJ Governor Kazuo Ueda maintained a slightly hawkish stance, warning that high energy import costs could raise inflation risks and hinting that the bank remains ready to raise rates later this year.
Overall FX market direction continues to be shaped by developments in the Middle East. President Trump announced that U.S. and Iranian officials will resume direct talks on Monday.

Strategists at Bank of America Global Research noted that despite prevailing bearish sentiment on the yen – driven by continued outflows of Japanese capital and policy‑risk concerns under the Takaichi administration – the U.S.–Japan joint intervention is a significant turning point.

BofA believes the 155‑yen level could become a key “pivot point” in the FX market. The strategists point out that during earlier official interventions this year, the dollar/yen pair found strong support near 155, leading many to conclude that official actions have limited impact.

Nevertheless, if the exchange rate clearly breaks below 155, trading patterns may shift from “buy the dip in dollars” to “sell dollars on a rebound,” and corporate hedging‑driven dollar‑selling pressure could accelerate that shift.

Shusuke Yamada, BofA Securities FX and rates strategist, said, “U.S. participation in the coordinated intervention raises market expectations for a broader policy framework aimed at stabilising the yen.”

He added, “Because the United States is involved, the limitation of depleting foreign‑exchange reserves unilaterally is effectively removed, making it harder for speculative funds to oppose official actions.”

To mitigate any impact of dollar sales on the U.S. Treasury market, both Japan’s finance minister and Treasury Secretary Bessent said they would use the Fed’s Foreign and International Monetary Authorities (FIMA) repo facility to provide liquidity support.

BofA also noted that the joint intervention has heightened expectations that the BoJ will accelerate its rate‑hiking pace, moving a market‑expected 100‑basis‑point hike from October to possibly September.

Meanwhile, Trump confirmed that a previously planned military strike has been cancelled in favour of diplomatic negotiations to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, sending international crude prices down more than 4% and sharply cooling short‑term concerns that energy prices will drive inflation.

With the geopolitical‑risk premium easing slightly, the FX market will now turn its focus to a series of key U.S. economic releases due later this week, which will help gauge the Fed’s September rate‑policy direction. The most closely watched data are the upcoming labour‑market figures, with the July non‑farm payroll report serving as the headline release.

items.title: 科技巨頭不香了？美股「估值鴻溝」消失 下一波機會浮現
items.title_en: Tech Giants No Longer in Favor? US Stock 'Valuation Chasm' Disappears, Next Opportunity Emerges
paras: 這個夏天，以人工智慧（AI）題材為首的動能股漲勢遭遇亂流，投資人先前瘋狂追高的熱情，如今已轉為動盪與不安。然而，高盛認為這波熱門股的修正行情，反而為投資人創造了絕佳的布局機會。
由奧本海默（Peter Oppenheimer）領軍的高盛策略團隊周一 (3 日) 發布最新報告指出，市場正重新評估大型科技公司的估值，其本益比（P/E ratio）下修，主要受到投資人擔憂資本支出未來可能帶來的報酬率影響。
高盛數據顯示，美股市值最大的 5 家公司，目前本益比僅略高於其餘 495 家公司，過去自 2017 年以來長期享有的估值溢價已大幅消失。
奧本海默及其團隊分析：「這與網際網路泡沫時期有本質上的差異。當年，估值漲至極高水位後，隨之而來的是股價崩跌；反觀此次，雖然股價經歷了溫和修正，但企業獲利仍表現極其強韌。」
從全球市場來看，科技產業相較其他產業的本益比溢價，已從本世紀初接近 200% 的高點，大幅降至目前約 20%。隨著科技股領導地位轉向硬體領域，尤其是晶片股，其獲利成長主要受到強勁 AI 需求推動。
不過，高盛指出，這些企業本質上仍具有高度週期性，市場也開始擔憂其獲利成長是否能持續，因此相關股票估值同樣遭到下修。儘管晶片股估值已經回落，但市場隱含的未來成長預期仍持續升高，且距離網路泡沫時期的高峰仍有相當差距。
此外，資金輪動效應已外溢至其他領域，拉抬了長期被市場冷落的「舊經濟」產業之成長預期與估值。其中，工業類股目前估值已升至產業近 20 年區間高點，高於科技類股；科技類股目前估值則回到近 20 年平均水準。
事實上，消費必需品、非必需消費品及醫療保健類股的估值，目前甚至超越了資訊科技或通訊服務產業。
高盛強調，即便獲利亮眼，美股最大權值股與最大產業的估值仍遭壓縮，導致整體本益比下滑。然而，若從股東權益報酬率（ROE）的視角觀察，美股仍是目前最具吸引力的市場。
報告並提到，僅有中國市場的 ROE 低於歷史平均，且獲利能力明顯遜色。
因此高盛建議，這種估值修正給了投資人重新切入美股的契機，同時可透過跨區域配置達到分散風險的效果。
此外，高盛美國股票首席策略師史奈德（Ben Snider）領導的團隊在另一份報告中指出，對動能股投資人而言，歷史經驗也站在多方一側。他表示，過去數十年間最強勁的動能股漲勢，通常會在大幅回檔後進入一段類似近期跌勢後的盤整期。
高盛策略團隊總結，歷史走勢與近期避險基金及 ETF 投資人出現的大幅去槓桿現象均顯示，市場資金輪動帶來的波動，未來幾週可能逐漸減弱。
paras_en: This summer, the momentum stocks led by the AI theme have encountered turbulence, and the enthusiasm of investors who previously chased them has turned into turmoil and anxiety. However, Goldman Sachs believes that the correction in these popular stocks has created an excellent opportunity for investors to layout.

The Goldman Sachs strategy team, led by Peter Oppenheimer, released a report on Monday (3rd) stating that the market is re-evaluating the valuations of large tech companies, with their price-to-earnings (P/E) ratios being revised downward, mainly due to concerns about the potential impact of future capital expenditures on returns.

According to Goldman Sachs data, the P/E ratio of the top 5 US stocks by market capitalization is now only slightly higher than that of the remaining 495 companies, with the long-term valuation premium they have enjoyed since 2017 largely disappearing.

Oppenheimer and his team analyzed: 'This is fundamentally different from the internet bubble period. At that time, after valuations rose to extremely high levels, stock prices plummeted; in contrast, this time, although stock prices have experienced a mild correction, corporate earnings have remained extremely strong.'

From a global market perspective, the valuation premium of the tech industry compared to other industries has fallen from nearly 200% at the beginning of the century to around 20% currently, with the leadership of the tech sector shifting to the hardware sector, particularly chip stocks, driven by strong AI demand.

However, Goldman Sachs pointed out that these companies are still highly cyclical, and the market has begun to worry about whether their earnings growth can be sustained, resulting in their stock valuations being revised downward. Although chip stock valuations have fallen, the market's implied expectations for future growth continue to rise, and are still far from the peak of the internet bubble period.

Furthermore, the fund rotation effect has spilled over to other fields, lifting the growth expectations and valuations of 'old economy' industries that have long been neglected by the market. Among them, the valuation of industrial stocks has risen to a near 20-year high, surpassing that of tech stocks; the valuation of tech stocks has returned to its 20-year average.
In fact, the valuations of consumer staples, non-essential consumer goods, and healthcare stocks have even surpassed those of the information technology or communication services industries.

Goldman Sachs emphasized that even with bright earnings, the valuations of the largest US stocks and industries have been compressed, leading to a decline in overall P/E ratios. However, from the perspective of return on equity (ROE), the US stock market is still the most attractive.
The report also mentioned that only the Chinese market has an ROE below its historical average, with significantly weaker profitability.

Therefore, Goldman Sachs suggests that this valuation correction has given investors an opportunity to re-enter the US stock market, while also achieving risk diversification through cross-regional allocation.

Additionally, a report by Goldman Sachs' US stock chief strategist Ben Snider and his team noted that for momentum stock investors, historical experience is also on the bullish side. He stated that the strongest momentum stock rallies over the past few decades usually enter a consolidation period after a sharp pullback, similar to the recent decline.

items.title: 美股最糟時刻過了？華爾街三大專家示警：通膨、高利率與AI恐掀下一波震盪
items.title_en: Has the Worst of the US Stock Market Passed? Wall Street Experts Warn of Inflation, High Interest Rates, and AI-Driven Volatility
paras: 隨著美股剛剛走過數月來最顛簸的一段行情，投資人擔憂股市的苦日子到底是已經過去，還是才剛要開始。儘管在三位長期為市場走向把脈的策略師與基金經理人中，沒有一位斷言後市必然再度重挫，但三人不約而同點出同樣的隱憂：通貨膨脹捲土重來、利率居高難下，以及一波才剛啟動的波動行情。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，上週五（31 日）美股收出七月份的最終成績單。然而，這個月幾乎吃掉了夏季以來科技股的漲幅。
根據 FactSet 資料，那斯達克綜合指數七月重挫 3.2%，創下三月以來最差月度表現；標普 500 小跌 0.1%；道瓊工業指數則勉強收紅 0.3%。
科技股本月承受沉重賣壓，投資人愈來愈焦慮於 AI 基礎建設驚人的燒錢速度，質疑雲端業者鉅額資本支出究竟何時才能真正轉化為獲利。
能源市場的劇烈震盪更加深了市場的不安，美國與伊朗軍事衝突升溫，油價劇烈擺盪，市場擔憂戰火可能進一步擴散至整個中東地區。
與此同時，聯準會（Fed）維持利率不變的決定，也未能替市場注入定心丸。本週包括十年期與三十年期美債殖利率等長端利率大幅攀升，反映投資人押注央行今年稍晚可能採取更強硬的緊縮立場。
以下是三位華爾街專家的看法，以及他們觀點的分歧之處。

通膨重返市場主導地位

Ritholtz Wealth Management 首席市場策略師 Callie Cox 認為，投資人必須做好迎接更多市場震盪的準備，通膨將重新成為左右大盤走勢的關鍵力量。
她表示：「我不是說這一定會發生，但目前的環境已經夠讓人厭倦了，而且許多指標都處於歷史高點，一旦市場真要反彈走高，恢復的過程恐怕會更加艱難。」
Cox 補充說：「必須理解，通膨目前是股票投資組合面臨的最大風險。同時，展望年底, 經濟成長動能看起來也並不穩固。」
近期公布的經濟數據，包括最新的消費者物價指數（CPI）與個人消費支出（PCE）報告都顯示，至少在六月，通膨已出現降溫跡象。然而七月油價重新上揚，卻可能抹去部分已取得的進展。
Cox 強調，目前推升通膨的因素，不至於重演 2022 年那種由疫情供應鏈斷裂與巨額財政刺激所引發的物價危機。然而，在牛市已連續走了將近四年之後，利率的不確定性與通膨壓力可能已足以「持續動搖」股價根基。

AI 熱潮推升通膨，高利率恐成科技股新麻煩

除了能源價格上漲，AI 需求激增同樣可能助燃通膨。
GQG Partners 基金經理人 Brian Kersmanc 指出，記憶體晶片等資料中心與 AI 基礎設施大量使用的零組件價格上揚，將墊高企業成本，最終可能轉嫁給消費者。
Kersmanc 表示：「通膨某種程度上是一種情緒驅動的現象，只要人們相信通膨會發生，他們的消費行為就會依照這種預期去反應。所以通膨持續的時間越久、越根深蒂固，就越容易自我實現，繼續往前推進。」
因此，對利率敏感的科技板塊，尤其是晶片股而言，估值過高的公司將更容易受到利率上升的衝擊，因為這些企業的預期營收與獲利，有相當大一部分來自遙遠的未來，一旦以更高的利率折現，這些未來現金流的當前價值就會大幅縮水。
不過，Kersmanc 也提到，通膨對科技業未必全是壞事，反而可能帶來一種次級的正面效應。利率走高不僅會壓縮股票估值，也可能讓企業重新盤算，降低或放緩資本支出的意願與能力。
他說：「我反而認為，就目前情況而言，通膨對雲端服務巨頭可能是件好事，因為市場一直在擔心他們到底要燒多少錢。」

戰事陰影籠罩，資金板塊輪動加劇

七月大盤整體表現平淡，卻掩蓋了市場內部暗潮洶湧的板塊輪動。
儘管大型科技股與半導體股遭遇拋售，但根據 FactSet 數據，同期標普 500 等權重指數上漲 1.3%，遠優於市值加權指數 0.1% 的小跌。
Infrastructure Capital Advisors 執行長暨投資長 Jay Hatfield 表示：「在戰爭陰霾的籠罩下，市場現在能做的，其實就是不斷輪動。」
根據 FactSet 統計，標普 500 的 11 大板塊中，有 7 個板塊在七月收紅，僅資訊科技、工業、原材料與公用事業板塊表現疲弱。
Hatfield 在電話採訪中說：「按照慣例，七月通常會因為財報表現良好而出現全面性上漲。但這一次因為戰爭陰影未散，我們認為部分避險基金可能仍在持續爆倉，其平倉賣壓恐怕還沒有完全結束，將持續為市場帶來波動。」
paras_en: As the US stock market has just experienced its most turbulent period in months, investors are worried about whether the tough days are over or just beginning. Although none of the three long-term market strategists and fund managers predicted a certain downturn, they all pointed out the same concerns: the return of inflation, high interest rates, and a new wave of market volatility.
According to a MarketWatch report, the US stock market closed on Friday with its final score for July. However, this month almost wiped out the gains in tech stocks since the summer.
According to FactSet data, the Nasdaq Composite Index fell 3.2% in July, its worst monthly performance since March, while the S&P 500 fell 0.1% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.3%.

Tech stocks faced heavy selling pressure this month as investors became increasingly anxious about the rapid cash burn of AI infrastructure, questioning when the huge capital expenditures of cloud service providers would eventually translate into profits.

The violent fluctuations in the energy market further deepened market anxiety, with the US-Iran military conflict escalating and oil prices fluctuating wildly, making the market worry that the war could spread to the entire Middle East.

Meanwhile, the Federal Reserve's decision to keep interest rates unchanged failed to reassure the market. This week, long-term interest rates, including the 10-year and 30-year US Treasury yields, rose sharply, reflecting investors' bets that the central bank may take a tougher stance on tightening later this year.
The following are the views of three Wall Street experts and the differences in their perspectives.

Inflation returns to the market's dominant position. Callie Cox, chief market strategist at Ritholtz Wealth Management, believes that investors must prepare for more market volatility, as inflation will become a key factor driving the market.

She said, 'I'm not saying it will happen, but the current environment is already frustrating, and many indicators are at historical highs. If the market really wants to rebound, the recovery process may be more difficult.'
Cox added, 'We must understand that inflation is currently the biggest risk facing stock portfolios. At the same time, looking at the end of the year, economic growth momentum does not look solid.'

Recent economic data, including the latest consumer price index (CPI) and personal consumption expenditure (PCE) reports, showed that inflation had eased in June. However, the rebound in oil prices in July may have erased some of the progress made.

Cox emphasized that the current factors driving inflation are not as severe as the price crisis caused by the pandemic supply chain disruptions and massive fiscal stimulus in 2022. However, after nearly four years of bull market, the uncertainty of interest rates and inflation pressure may be enough to 'continuously shake' the foundation of stock prices.
The AI boom may fuel inflation, and high interest rates may become a new problem for tech stocks.

Brian Kersmanc, a fund manager at GQG Partners, pointed out that the rising prices of components such as memory chips, which are widely used in data centers and AI infrastructure, will increase corporate costs and may eventually be passed on to consumers.

Kersmanc said, 'Inflation is to some extent an emotionally driven phenomenon. As long as people believe that inflation will happen, their consumption behavior will react accordingly. So the longer inflation persists, the more it will self-reinforce and continue to push forward.'

Therefore, for the tech sector, which is sensitive to interest rates, especially chip stocks, companies with high valuations will be more vulnerable to the impact of rising interest rates, as a significant portion of their expected revenue and profits come from the distant future. If these future cash flows are discounted at a higher interest rate, their present value will shrink significantly.

However, Kersmanc also mentioned that inflation may not be all bad for the tech industry, as it could bring a secondary positive effect. Rising interest rates will not only compress stock valuations but also make companies reassess and reduce their capital expenditures.
He said, 'I think that, given the current situation, inflation may be a good thing for cloud service giants, as the market has been worried about how much money they will burn.'
The shadow of war looms, and sector rotation intensifies. The overall performance of the market in July was flat, but it hid the underlying sector rotation.

Although large tech stocks and semiconductor stocks were sold off, the S&P 500 equal-weight index rose 1.3% during the same period, outperforming the 0.1% decline in the market-capitalization-weighted index.
Jay Hatfield, CEO and chief investment officer of Infrastructure Capital Advisors, said, 'Under the shadow of war, the market can only keep rotating.'
According to FactSet statistics, seven of the 11 sectors in the S&P 500 index rose in July, with only the information technology, industrial, materials, and utilities sectors performing poorly.

Hatfield said in a phone interview, 'Traditionally, July usually sees a broad rally due to good earnings reports. But this time, due to the shadow of war, we believe that some hedge funds may still be liquidating, and the selling pressure may not have ended, which will continue to bring volatility to the market.'

items.title: 從歷史高點回馬槍砍11%！美半導體股前景分化 分析師建議這樣做
items.title_en: Semiconductor Stocks Plunge 11% from Historic High: Analysts Suggest a Selective Approach
paras: 近期，半導體產業經歷一輪劇烈波動，費城半導體指數自 6 月歷史高點回撤逾 11%，但年內仍維持約 83% 的漲幅。費半指數漲勢背後的核心驅動力是 AI 帶動的記憶體晶片需求爆發。
根據世界半導體貿易統計組織預測，今年全球半導體市場規模可望達到 1.51 兆美元，年增約 90%，其中記憶體晶片市場預計成長近 250%。
然而，隨著股價走高，市場分歧正在加劇。一方面，AI 基礎設施投資持續擴大，全球雲端和 AI 基礎設施資本支出預計到 2027 年將接近 1.5 兆美元。
摩根大通則維持半導體族群「增持」評級，認為 AI 相關運算、記憶體和網路設備供應鏈將持續受益。
花旗則推薦博通、德州儀器和應用材料作為首選標的，認為近期回檔屬於健康現象。
另一方面，高估值和 AI 投資回報的不確定性令投資者擔憂。
今年以來，主導股市走勢的半導體單邊行情正分崩離析，引發令人揪心的劇烈波動，投資人愈發擔憂 AI 支出狂潮恐難以為繼。
費半指數 7 月重挫 21%，創 2008 年 10 月全球金融危機最嚴峻時期以來單月最差表現。
在 7 月交易日的近半數期間，追蹤全球 30 家最大晶片製造商的費半指數中，收盤漲跌幅均不低於 4%，全部 22 個交易日盤中波幅至少達 2%，此種景象自 2020 年後便未曾出現。
另有數據顯示，追蹤美國半導體股票的基金在 6 月最後一周錄得約 110 億美元的資金流出，創本世紀最大單週流出紀錄。
做空力量也在積聚，主要半導體公司的空頭部位已升至三年高點。Interactive Brokers 首席市場分析師指出，儘管獲利成長前所未有，但關鍵在於這種勢頭能持續多久。
分析師建議投資人採取選擇性策略，關注結構性成長機會，同時對週期性風險保持警惕。
Pave Finance 投資長 Stephen Evans 說：「這種波動真實反映了當前普遍存在的不確定性，沒人知道事態將如何演變。我認為本輪晶片週期仍有空間延續，投資者仍可持有多頭部位，但前提是，你必須經得起像是迪士尼樂園雲霄飛車般的考驗。」
paras_en: The semiconductor industry has experienced a sharp volatility in recent times, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX) retreating over 11% from its historic high in June, but still maintaining an 83% year-to-date gain. The index's upward momentum is driven by the explosive demand for AI-driven memory chips.

According to the World Semiconductor Trade Statistics (WSTS) organization, the global semiconductor market is expected to reach $1.51 trillion this year, with a year-over-year growth of approximately 90%. The memory chip market is forecast to grow by nearly 250%.

However, as stock prices rise, market divergence is intensifying. On one hand, AI infrastructure investment continues to expand, with global cloud and AI infrastructure capital expenditures expected to reach $1.5 trillion by 2027.
Morgan Stanley maintains a 'buy' rating for the semiconductor group, citing the continued benefits to AI-related computing, memory, and network equipment supply chains.
Goldman Sachs recommends Broadcom, Texas Instruments, and Applied Materials as top picks, viewing the recent pullback as a healthy phenomenon.
On the other hand, overvaluation and uncertainty surrounding AI investment returns are causing investors to worry.
This year, the semiconductor-dominated market trend has begun to break down, triggering intense volatility and concerns that the AI spending frenzy may not be sustainable.
The SOX index plummeted 21% in July, its worst monthly performance since the 2008 global financial crisis.

During the July trading period, the SOX index, which tracks the 30 largest chip manufacturers globally, saw daily price swings of at least 4% in nearly half of the trading days, with a maximum intraday range of 2% in all 22 trading days. This phenomenon has not been seen since 2020.

Data also shows that funds tracking US semiconductor stocks experienced a net outflow of approximately $11 billion in the last week of June, setting a record for the largest single-week outflow in the century.

Short-selling pressure is also building, with short positions in major semiconductor companies reaching a three-year high. Interactive Brokers' chief market analyst noted that despite unprecedented profit growth, the key question is how long this trend can sustain.
Analysts recommend a selective approach, focusing on structural growth opportunities while being cautious of cyclical risks.

Pave Finance's investment director, Stephen Evans, said: 'This volatility is a reflection of the widespread uncertainty, and no one knows how things will unfold. I believe there's still room for this chip cycle to extend, and investors can still hold long positions, but they need to be prepared for the rollercoaster ride.'

items.title: 伊朗戰爭推升油價！川普開轟雪佛龍、埃克森美孚賺太多：應降價回饋民眾
items.title_en: Trump Slams ExxonMobil and Chevron for Profiting Too Much from Iran War
paras: 美國總統川普 (Donald Trump) 周一 (3 日) 表示，埃克森美孚 (Exxon Mobil)(XOM-US) 與雪佛龍 (Chevron)(CVX-US) 在伊朗戰爭推升原油價格的過程中「賺太多了」，並要求兩家公司「把一部分獲利回饋給民眾」，與他一貫支持石油業的立場相左。
川普在白宮向媒體說：「他們因供應短缺賺了太多錢，我不喜歡這樣。」
就在三天前，兩家公司公布亮眼的第 2 季財報，在伊朗戰爭持續推升油價帶動下獲利大增：雪佛龍第 2 季淨利激增近 400% 至 120 億美元，優於去年同期的 25 億美元，埃克森美孚獲利則從去年同期的 71 億美元倍增至 145 億美元。
川普說：「雪佛龍賺太多，埃克森美孚也賺太多。他們應該把部分獲利回饋給民眾，而且最好調降零售價格，也就是消費者支付的價格。」
川普一向透過公開施壓要求企業改變經營作法，經常利用社群媒體或接受媒體訪問時點名企業。他在第一任期時曾要求汽車製造商將生產留在美國、批評國防承包商成本過高，並敦促藥廠調降藥價。
重返白宮後，川普延續這種作法，經常利用擔任總統的影響力、而非正式政府措施，試圖左右企業決策。
川普稍早也點名雪佛龍執行長 Mike Wirth 日前接受 Fox News 節目訪問時，未提及川普政府對石油產業的支持。他在 Truth Social 上發文說：「他唯一刻意忽略的是，若沒有川普政府的智慧、遠見、實力與穩定，石油產業甚至整個美國都會完蛋！」
川普並舉例指出：「他們曾把 Mike 和雪佛龍趕出委內瑞拉，如今又回去了，而且規模比以往更大、更強，預料將大賺一筆。」
雪佛龍在委內瑞拉經營已超過 100 年。2007 年前總統查維茲 (Hugo Chavez) 推動石油產業國有化時，雪佛龍選擇留在當地；埃克森美孚與 ConocoPhillips 則退出委內瑞拉市場。
雪佛龍股價周一震盪走低，終場收低 1.85%，埃克森美孚也跌 0.24%。。不過在川普發表評論之前，兩大石油股就已呈現下跌格局，因在川普周末取消原訂對伊朗發動的「大規模攻擊」下，國際油價周一下跌約 5%。
伊朗戰爭推升汽油價格，加上民生成本壓力，已成為川普在 11 月期中選舉前的政治風險，而共和黨正力拚保住國會控制權。目前全美汽油平均價格約每加侖 4.10 美元，較美國與以色列今年稍早對伊朗發動攻擊前上漲逾 30%。
和國際油價相比，加油站油價通常反映較慢，代表周末的跌勢不一定會帶動汽油價格立即下滑。
paras_en: US President Donald Trump on Monday said that ExxonMobil (XOM-US) and Chevron (CVX-US) have made too much money from the Iran war-driven oil price surge and should return some of their profits to the public.
Trump made the comments at the White House, saying, "They made too much money because of the supply shortage, and I don't like that."

Just three days ago, the two companies released impressive second-quarter earnings reports, with Chevron's net income soaring nearly 400% to $12 billion, beating last year's $2.5 billion, and ExxonMobil's earnings more than doubling to $14.5 billion from last year's $7.1 billion.

Trump said, "Chevron made too much, ExxonMobil made too much. They should give back some of their profits to the public, and it would be great if they could lower their retail prices, which is what consumers pay."
Trump has a history of using public pressure to force companies to change their business practices, often using social media or media interviews to name and shame companies.
During his first term, he asked car manufacturers to keep production in the US, criticized defense contractors for high costs, and urged pharmaceutical companies to lower drug prices.
Returning to the White House, Trump continued this approach, often using his presidential influence rather than formal government measures to try to shape corporate decisions.
Trump also singled out Chevron CEO Mike Wirth, who recently appeared on Fox News and failed to mention the Trump administration's support for the oil industry.

On Truth Social, Trump wrote, "The only thing he deliberately ignored is that without the wisdom, foresight, strength, and stability of the Trump administration, the oil industry and even the entire US would have been wiped out!"

Trump also pointed out that Chevron had previously been forced out of Venezuela, but had since returned and was now operating on a larger and stronger scale, "and they're going to make a lot of money," he said.

Chevron has been operating in Venezuela for over 100 years. In 2007, before President Hugo Chavez nationalized the oil industry, Chevron chose to stay in the country, while ExxonMobil and ConocoPhillips exited the Venezuelan market.

Chevron's stock price fell 1.85% on Monday, while ExxonMobil dropped 0.24%. However, the two oil stocks had already been trending downward before Trump's comments, as international oil prices fell around 5% after Trump canceled a planned "massive attack" on Iran over the weekend.

The Iran war-driven oil price surge, combined with rising consumer costs, has become a political risk for Trump ahead of the November midterm elections, as the Republican Party fights to maintain control of Congress.
The current US average gas price is around $4.10 per gallon, up over 30% from before the US and Israel launched attacks on Iran earlier this year.
Gas station prices typically reflect international oil prices with a lag, so it's unclear whether the recent price drop will immediately translate to lower gas prices for consumers.

items.title: 華爾街大行：美股最猛烈拋售或已過 但「抄底」仍有風險
items.title_en: Wall Street Strategists: US Stock Sell-Off May Be Over, But 'Bottom Fishing' Still a Risk
paras: 在經歷了一個月的劇烈震盪後，美股市場正站在一個關鍵的十字路口。一方面，摩根大通等機構的數據表明，科技板塊持續數月的去槓桿進程已接近尾聲，槓桿 ETF、對沖基金淨暴露和 CTA 倉位均已從極端水平顯著回落。另一方面，通膨擔憂重新升溫、利率路徑充滿不確定性、AI 資本開支回報疑慮仍未消散。
宏觀風險正在接替倉位清理，成為市場定價的核心驅動力。進入 8 月，摩根大通、高盛、法國興業銀行等華爾街大行密集發布策略報告，勾勒出一幅「去槓桿接近尾聲、估值重新合理、但宏觀風險仍在積聚」的複雜圖景。
科技股最猛烈拋售或已經過去
據《智通財經》，過去兩個月，全球科技股經歷了一場由槓桿清盤驅動的「完美風暴」。摩根大通策略師 Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou 團隊在最新報告中指出，科技板塊去槓桿最猛烈的階段大概率已經過去。

數據顯示，槓桿 ETF 規模已從峰值的 500 億美元降至 170 億美元；對沖基金在科技板塊的淨暴露從 5.0 個標準差降至 1.7 個標準差；CTA（商品交易顧問）倉位已回落至 39% 分位。在韓國市場，槓桿 ETF 的平倉操作已基本完成，對沖基金的去槓桿進程也已完成約 90%，整體槓桿水平正回落至更為合理的區間。摩根大通認為，投資者在科技和半導體領域（包括記憶體股票）的去槓桿化進程比此前預期更快，進一步去槓桿的空間已經非常有限。
高盛的數據同樣印證了這一判斷。全球科技敞口經歷了五年多以來最大規模賣出，韓國股票槓桿 ETF 的資產管理規模從 6 月高點的 530 億美元降至 150 億美元。基本面多空客戶對動量因子的槓桿敞口已經降到過去一年區間的第 28 百分位。「擁擠交易從『人人都在車上』，變成了相當一部分人已經下車，甚至是被迫下車」。
對沖基金倉位監測數據給出三組明確信號：全市場對沖基金持倉與因子表現合併 z 值跌至歷史極端偏低區間；北美對沖基金五天維度的減倉幅度對應 3 倍標準差，持續大規模的拋售行為已經走到尾聲。記憶體板塊正迎來重新定價機會——當前股價僅隱含一年高景氣週期，若上漲週期延續至 2027 年中，估值將回到歷史均值以下。
然而，去槓桿的結束並不意味著市場將一帆風順。高盛頂級交易團隊警告，儘管去槓桿進程接近尾聲，但風險並未完全出清，多重關鍵事件仍將壓制市場。高盛最新《資金流向》報告指出，實質性降險尚未完成，受限於季節性基金流出和機構進攻意願不足，8 月美股上行缺乏「燃料」。
伴隨去槓桿的推進，全球股市的估值已經歷了顯著重置。美國股票估值相對於世界其他地區的溢價已縮水至約 22%，為六年多來最低水平，遠低於 31% 的十年平均水平。RBC 資本市場策略師 Lori Calvasina 指出，納斯達克 100 指數、標普 500 指數乃至科技板塊的估值都開始再次顯得「合理」。
同時，剛剛落幕的第二季度業績期交出了一份堪稱「有史以來最強之一」的成績單。FactSet 數據顯示，標普 500 成分股公司本季度盈利有望實現 47.4% 的同比增長，為過去五年中盈利增長最強勁的一個季度。高盛統計顯示，已公布業績的成分股中，64% 的公司盈利超出華爾街預期至少一個標準差。
AI 基礎設施相關股票貢獻了二季度標普 500 約三分之一的 EPS 增長。高盛測算顯示，若剔除幾家科技巨頭異常龐大的投資收益，標普 500 整體盈利同比增幅約為 26%；計入後整體增幅更飆升至 45%。歐洲斯托克 600 指數成分股利潤在經歷兩年幾乎零增長後，本季度同比躍升 19%。
宏觀風險正在積聚：通膨與利率的「達摩克利斯之劍」
然而，業績期的盈利光芒並未驅散宏觀層面的陰霾。高盛衍生品專家 Lee Coppersmith 警告，隨著業績期結束，市場的注意力將重新轉向利率、通膨和經濟增長。美國國債波動性已開始再次加速，實際收益率仍接近週期高位。
通膨壓力依然頑固。法國興業銀行策略師 Alain Bokobza 團隊指出，美國第二輪關稅、AI 和基礎設施資本支出週期的加速增長、油價波動加劇以及發達經濟體持續的巨額財政赤字，都表明市場對通膨的預期「要低得多」。法國興業銀行預計今年核心 PCE 將維持在 3% 以上，並建議配置 TIPS、銅和黃金作為通膨對沖工具。
美債市場正在為這一擔憂定價。10 年期美債收益率已攀升至 4.74% 附近，30 年期突破 5.27%，創近 19 年新高。摩根大通已將 10 年期美債收益率預測上調至 4.85%，30 年期目標上調至 5.40%。收益率曲線陡峭化在歷史上極為罕見——市場正對聯準會能否守住 2% 通膨目標投下不信任票。
聯準會利率路徑充滿不確定性。7 月 29 日 FOMC 會議以 9 比 3 維持利率不變，三名鷹派委員投下反對票主張加息 25 個點子。市場對 9-10 月加息的預期已打得非常滿，合計約 90%。與此同時，高盛副董事長、前達拉斯 Fed 主席 Robert Kaplan 最新明確警告，若通膨數據未能降溫，聯準會最早可能在秋季重啟加息，且這大概率不是單次行動，而是連續 2 至 3 次的系列收緊。
在去槓桿接近尾聲、估值重置完成、但宏觀風險仍在積聚的背景下，華爾街策略師們正勾勒出一幅全新的投資藍圖。摩根大通強調，記憶體板塊正迎來重新定價機會，倉位已不再是主要矛盾，基本面和估值將決定方向。
從市值加權到等權重。標普 500 等權重指數 7 月實際上漲 1.3%，而市值加權的標普 500 同期下跌 0.1%。高盛指出，等權重標普、低波動標普、剔除 AI 後的標普 500 在 7 月最後一週均創下歷史新高。這意味著市場的上漲正從「少數大牛領漲」轉向更廣泛的行業參與。

法國興業銀行推薦做多標普 500 等權重指數、做多美國抗通膨債券，同時做空 10 年期美國國債。策略師指出，美國第二輪關稅、AI 和基礎設施資本支出週期的加速增長、油價波動加劇以及發達經濟體持續高額的財政赤字，都表明市場目前對通膨的預期要低得多。法興銀行策略師 Manish Kabra 表示，當前有九個行業實現了雙位數的獲利增長，小型股工業 EPS 上升達 30%。他看好銀行股，預計 2026 年下半年將迎來反彈；同時推薦工業、公用事業和材料相關股票，以及「重返美國生產」主題。
RBC 資本市場維持標普 500 年底目標價 8150 點不變，認為更強勁的經濟增長和企業盈利可以推動市場再漲 11.4%。但策略師 Calvasina 也警告，在聯準會主席更迭的初期，標普 500 通常波動劇烈，「股市的走勢不會一帆風順」。
高盛維持標普 500 指數 2026 年底目標價 8000 點，隱含約 8% 的上行空間。但高盛交易員警告，隨著宏觀不確定性持續，發生「高相關性事件」的可能性正在上升。交易員們正在針對大盤整體的協同波動進行套期保值——所謂的「反向離散度交易」被高盛列為應對當前市場的最佳策略之一。
Coppersmith 指出，隨著業績期結束，市場注意力將重新轉向利率、通膨和經濟增長，「美國國債波動性已開始再次加速，實際收益率仍接近週期高位，而從歷史經驗來看，在這種環境下，股票波動性通常不會保持結構性收窄」。
高盛對沖基金業務負責人 Tony Pasquariello 指出，過去一個月「一隻重錘砸穿了共識倉位」，最擁擠、最順手、最容易被加槓桿追逐的交易已經被迫降溫，但風險並未消失。
paras_en: After a month of intense volatility, the US stock market is at a critical juncture. On one hand, data from institutions such as Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs shows that the tech sector's deleveraging process has nearly come to an end, with leveraged ETFs, hedge fund net exposure, and CTA positions all significantly declining from extreme levels. On the other hand, inflation concerns are resurfacing, interest rate paths are uncertain, and AI capital expenditure return concerns remain unresolved.

Macro risks are replacing position clearing as the core drivers of market pricing. As August begins, Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, and BNP Paribas are releasing strategy reports, painting a complex picture of a deleveraging process nearing its end, with valuations becoming reasonable, but macro risks still accumulating.

Tech stocks' sell-off may be over. According to Bloomberg, over the past two months, global tech stocks have experienced a 'perfect storm' driven by deleveraging. Morgan Stanley strategist Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou's team notes that the tech sector's deleveraging process has likely reached its peak.

Data shows that leveraged ETFs have shrunk from a peak of $500 billion to $170 billion; hedge fund net exposure in the tech sector has declined from 5.0 standard deviations to 1.7 standard deviations; and CTA positions have fallen to 39% percentile. In the Korean market, leveraged ETFs have completed their unwinding, and hedge fund deleveraging has reached approximately 90%, with overall leverage declining to a more reasonable range. Morgan Stanley believes that investors have deleveraged faster than expected in the tech and semiconductor sectors (including memory stocks), leaving little room for further deleveraging.

Goldman Sachs' data also supports this assessment. Global tech net exposure has experienced the largest sell-off in over five years, with Korean stock leveraged ETFs shrinking from a June peak of $53 billion to $15 billion. Fundamental long-short clients have reduced their momentum factor levered exposure to the 28th percentile of the past year. 'Overcrowding trades have gone from 'everyone's on the bus' to 'many have gotten off, and some have been forced off.'

Hedge fund net exposure monitoring data provides three clear signals: the combined z-score of hedge fund net exposure and factor performance has fallen to an extreme low in history; North American hedge funds have reduced their five-day net exposure by 3 standard deviations, indicating a large-scale sell-off has reached its end; and the memory sector is poised for re-pricing – current prices only imply a one-year high-growth cycle, and if the upcycle continues to 2027 mid-year, valuations will fall below historical means.

However, the end of deleveraging does not mean the market will sail smoothly. Goldman Sachs' top trading team warns that while deleveraging is nearing its end, risks have not been fully cleared, and multiple key events will continue to pressure the market. Goldman Sachs' latest 'Capital Flows' report notes that actual rate cuts have not yet occurred, limited by seasonal fund outflows and insufficient institutional buying intent, leaving August US stock gains lacking 'fuel.'

As deleveraging advances, global equity valuations have undergone a significant reset. US stock valuations relative to other regions have shrunk to around 22%, the lowest level in over six years, far below the 31% ten-year average. RBC Capital Markets strategist Lori Calvasina notes that the Nasdaq 100, S&P 500, and tech sector valuations have become 'reasonable' again.

Meanwhile, the recently concluded second-quarter earnings season has delivered a 'one of the strongest ever' performance. FactSet data shows that S&P 500 component companies are expected to report a 47.4% year-over-year earnings growth, the strongest quarterly growth in the past five years. Goldman Sachs' statistics show that 64% of the component companies that have reported earnings have beaten analyst expectations by at least one standard deviation.

AI infrastructure-related stocks contributed approximately one-third of the S&P 500's EPS growth in the second quarter. Goldman Sachs estimates that, excluding a few tech giants' abnormal investment returns, the S&P 500's overall earnings growth would be around 26%, and including them, the growth would be around 45%. The European Stoxx 600 index's earnings have risen 19% year-over-year after two years of almost zero growth.

However, the earnings season's earnings growth has not dispelled macro-level concerns. Goldman Sachs' derivatives expert Lee Coppersmith warns that, as the earnings season ends, market attention will shift back to interest rates, inflation, and economic growth. US Treasury volatility has begun to accelerate again, with actual yields near cycle highs.

Inflation pressures remain stubborn. BNP Paribas strategist Alain Bokobza's team notes that the US second-round tariffs, AI and infrastructure capital expenditure cycles, oil price volatility, and developed economies' persistent large fiscal deficits all indicate that market expectations for inflation are 'too low.' BNP Paribas expects core PCE to remain above 3% this year and recommends allocating to TIPS, copper, and gold as inflation hedges.

The US Treasury market is pricing in this concern. The 10-year Treasury yield has risen to around 4.74%, and the 30-year yield has broken through 5.27%, a nearly 19-year high. Morgan Stanley has raised its 10-year Treasury yield forecast to 4.85% and its 30-year target to 5.40%. The yield curve's steepening is extremely rare in history – the market is questioning the Fed's ability to maintain its 2% inflation target.

The Fed's interest rate path is uncertain. The July 29 FOMC meeting ended with a 9-3 vote to keep rates unchanged, with three hawkish committee members voting against a 25-basis-point rate hike. Market expectations for a 9-10 October rate hike have reached around 90%. Meanwhile, Goldman Sachs' vice chairman and former Dallas Fed president Robert Kaplan has warned that, if inflation data does not cool, the Fed may restart rate hikes as early as autumn, and this is likely to be a series of 2-3 consecutive rate hikes.

Against the backdrop of deleveraging nearing its end, valuations being reset, but macro risks still accumulating, Wall Street strategists are sketching out a new investment landscape. Morgan Stanley emphasizes that the memory sector is poised for re-pricing, with positions no longer the primary concern, and fundamentals and valuations will determine direction.

From market-cap weighted to equal-weighted. The S&P 500 equal-weighted index actually rose 1.3% in July, while the market-cap weighted S&P 500 fell 0.1%. Goldman Sachs notes that the S&P 500 equal-weighted, low-volatility S&P 500, and S&P 500 excluding AI have all reached historical highs in the last week of July. This indicates that the market's upswing is shifting from 'a few big winners' to more widespread industry participation.

BNP Paribas recommends going long the S&P 500 equal-weighted index, going long US inflation-indexed bonds, and going short 10-year US Treasuries. Strategists note that the US second-round tariffs, AI and infrastructure capital expenditure cycles, oil price volatility, and developed economies' persistent large fiscal deficits all indicate that market expectations for inflation are 'too low.' BNP Paribas strategist Manish Kabra notes that nine industries have achieved double-digit earnings growth, and small-cap industrials' EPS has risen 30%. He likes bank stocks, expecting a rebound in the second half of 2026; he also recommends industrial, utility, and materials stocks, as well as the 'return to US production' theme.

RBC Capital Markets maintains its S&P 500 year-end target price of 8150 unchanged, believing that stronger economic growth and corporate earnings can drive an 11.4% market rally. However, strategist Calvasina also warns that, in the initial period of the Fed chairman's transition, the S&P 500 typically experiences significant volatility, and 'the market's trajectory will not be smooth.'

Goldman Sachs maintains its S&P 500 index year-end target price of 8000, implying around 8% upside. However, Goldman Sachs traders warn that, as macro uncertainty persists, the likelihood of 'high-correlation events' is increasing. Traders are engaging in 'reverse dispersion trading' – a strategy recommended by Goldman Sachs to address the current market environment.

Coppersmith notes that, as the earnings season ends, market attention will shift back to interest rates, inflation, and economic growth, 'US Treasury volatility has begun to accelerate again, with actual yields near cycle highs, and, from historical experience, stock volatility typically does not remain structurally compressed in this environment.'

Goldman Sachs' hedge fund business head Tony Pasquariello notes that 'one big hammer has crushed the consensus position' over the past month, with the most crowded, easiest-to-leverage trades being forced to unwind, but risks have not been eliminated.

items.title: 通用汽車獲喊「強力買進」！華爾街同步點名凱撒娛樂、高知特等4檔美股
items.title_en: GM, LAD, CTSH, SIRI, CZR: Wall Street Analysts Weigh In
paras: 美股財報季持續發燒，多家券商近期針對通用汽車 (GM-US) 、利西亞車行 (LAD-US) 、高知特科技 (CTSH-US) 、天狼星 XM 控股 (SIRI-US) 及凱撒娛樂 (CZR-US) 等公司發布最新研究報告，反映出市場對傳統產業轉型與併購題材的不同觀察角度。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，投資銀行 Tigress Financial Partners 重申對通用汽車的「強力買進」評等，並將十二個月目標價上調至 130 美元。
該機構認為，隨著新車型陸續推出，加上 AI 帶來的營運效率提升，以及軟體與國防領域的商機，通用汽車正逐步轉型為具備多重成長動能、高毛利率的投資標的。
通用汽車第二季財報顯示，其卡車與休旅車核心業務與快速擴張的軟體、國防及保險業務相互結合，正形成多重獲利成長引擎。隨著電動車相關費用大致落幕，該公司具備估值提升與持續為股東創造價值的潛力。
值得注意的是，通用汽車正與 OnStar、Super Cruise、Gemini 以及輝達 (NVDA-US) 合作，打造一個規模達十億英里、價值十億美元的軟體與 AI 業務，或重塑該公司的利潤率與成長故事。
與此同時，該公司的防務部門正積極發展一項規模可望達 10 億美元、年成長率超過 30% 的國防業務，將為通用的核心投資論述增添高利潤率、抗景氣循環的新優勢。
此外，通用汽車的資本配置策略也聚焦於持續再投資、推動製造回流美國，並加速提升股東報酬。

利西亞車行：財報表現亮眼，成本控管成關鍵

研究公司 Seaport Research Partners 對利西亞車行維持「買進」評等，目標價設定為 390 美元。
該公司第二季調整後每股盈餘達 10.03 美元，優於市場預期的 8.70 至 8.73 美元區間。
報告分析，利西亞車行本季表現全面優於預期，主要受惠於各項業務全面穩健表現，其中二手車毛利率以及銷售、一般及行政費用占毛利比重等領域均有顯著改善。
營收則與預期大致相符，二手車售價年增逾 4.3%，完全抵消了銷售量略低於預期（以及相關金融與保險業務）的影響。
從獲利率來看，各業務部門的毛利率皆優於預期。其中新車毛利與前一季幾乎持平，顯示市場進一步回歸正常；二手車毛利率較前一季增加 339 美元以上；服務與零件毛利率則較去年同期提升 160 個基點以上。
利西亞車行旗下的專屬金融服務機構 Driveway Finance 創下 3,700 萬美元的歷史新高獲利、8.84 億美元的歷史新高放款金額，以及 17.5% 的滲透率。
不過，利西亞車行本次獲利優於預期的最大推手，是銷售、一般及行政費用表現優於預期。
以調整後基礎計算，一般及行政費用占毛利比重為 68.6%，較前一季改善 290 個基點，單此一項便使每股盈餘較 Seaport 原先預估高出逾 1 美元。

高知特科技：金融業務帶動成長，但通訊板塊拖累估值

Susquehanna 證券對高知特科技維持「正向」評等，但將目標價下修至 82 美元。
受惠於銀行與金融服務業務成長 12%，高知特科技公布的業績成長略優於預期。
此外，公司接單表現穩健，共簽下 7 筆大型合約（其中包括一筆超大型合約），過去 12 個月的接單／營收比達 1.3 倍。
分析師認為，公司對第三、四季的展望相對審慎且可信，管理層對第四季能見度的掌握程度似乎優於預期。
Susquehanna 看好高知特科技銀行金融與醫療保健業務（尤其是 TriZetto 醫療行政解決方案）的表現，唯獨通訊、媒體與科技部門中的通訊業務相對疲弱。
儘管如此，考量目前估值倍數仍屬合理，加上業務組合具備領先優勢，該機構決定對高知特科技維持正向評等，僅因同業估值收斂而小幅下修目標價。

天狼星 XM 控股：股價動能來自頻譜題材，非營運面利多

Benchmark 股權研究對天狼星 XM 控股控股維持「買進」評等，但給予低於當前股價水準的 30 美元目標價。
報告認為，天狼星 XM 控股近期股價的上漲動能，主要歸因於市場重新積極關注其頻譜變現潛力，而非市場對執行長 Jennifer Witz 所推動、規劃完善的營運與策略措施給予更高評價。
分析師預期，頻譜經濟效益最終將主要透過合作夥伴關係以及公司內部的新應用來實現，而非再次透過一筆具有劃時代意義的科技、媒體與電信（TMT）產業併購交易來達成。
報告同時指出，天狼星 XM 控股核心的音訊訂閱業務，相較於有線寬頻，似乎較不容易出現斷崖式惡化；同時，就目前而言，其經濟效益也優於多數現行影音串流業務。

凱撒娛樂：併購案進行中，經營評估維持觀望

證券商 Texas Capital Securities 最新報告指出，凱撒娛樂第二季稅息折舊攤銷前利潤（EBITDA）較預期低約 4%，主要受到其拉斯維加斯大道業務與數位業務表現不如預期拖累，因此將公司 2026 與 2027 年 EBITDA 預估雙雙下修 1%。
報告指出，凱撒娛樂並未舉行財報電話會議，也未針對與 Fertitta Entertainment 達成的最終收購協議提供最新進展。
就各業務表現來看，扣除賭桌贏率偏低的影響後，拉斯維加斯大道業務 EBITDA 仍較市場共識預估低 4%；數位業務在調整贏率因素後大致符合預期；區域性業務 EBITDA 則優於預期 7%。
儘管下修獲利預估，Texas Capital Securities 仍維持 31 美元目標價，與 Fertitta Entertainment 提出的每股 31 美元全現金收購價一致。
該機構指出，截至 7 月 28 日，凱撒娛樂收盤價 29.84 美元，仍較收購價折價約 3.4%。考慮到目前併購市場環境及交易仍待完成，維持對該股的「中立」評級。
paras_en: The US auto sector has been on fire, with multiple brokerages recently publishing research reports on General Motors (GM-US), Lithia Motors (LAD-US), Convergys (CTSH-US), Sirius XM Holdings (SIRI-US), and Caesars Entertainment (CZR-US).
Tigress Financial Partners reiterated its "Strong Buy" rating on General Motors and raised its 12-month target price to $130.

The investment bank believes that General Motors is transforming into a multi-growth engine with high margins, driven by the launch of new models, AI-driven operational efficiency, and software and defense business opportunities.
The company's second-quarter earnings report showed that its core truck and SUV business is growing rapidly, while its software, defense, and insurance businesses are also expanding.
General Motors is working with OnStar, Super Cruise, Gemini, and NVIDIA (NVDA-US) to create a $10 billion software and AI business, which could reshape the company's profit margins and growth story.
The company's defense business is also growing, with a potential $1 billion revenue and over 30% annual growth rate, providing a new competitive advantage.
Lithia Motors: Earnings Beat Expectations, Cost Control Key
Seaport Research Partners maintained its "Buy" rating on Lithia Motors and set a $390 target price.
The company's second-quarter adjusted earnings per share (EPS) of $10.03 beat market expectations of $8.70 to $8.73.

The report noted that Lithia Motors' second-quarter performance was better than expected, driven by stable performance across all business segments, including used car margins and sales, general, and administrative expenses.

Revenue was in line with expectations, with used car prices increasing over 4.3% year-over-year, offsetting the impact of lower-than-expected sales volume and related financial and insurance business.
The company's Driveway Finance subsidiary achieved a record $37 million in earnings and $884 million in loan originations, with a 17.5% penetration rate.
The largest contributor to Lithia Motors' earnings beat was the company's sales, general, and administrative expenses, which improved by 290 basis points from the previous quarter.
Highmark Health: Financial Services Drive Growth, but Telecom Segment Weighs on Valuation
Susquehanna Securities maintained its "Positive" rating on Highmark Health but lowered its target price to $82.

The company's financial services business grew 12%, beating expectations, and the company signed seven large contracts, including one mega-deal, with a 1.3x order-to-revenue ratio over the past 12 months.
Analysts believe that the company's third- and fourth-quarter outlook is conservative and credible, with management's visibility into the fourth quarter seemingly better than expected.

Susquehanna likes Highmark Health's banking and financial services, as well as its healthcare business, particularly TriZetto's healthcare administrative solutions, but notes that the company's telecom segment is relatively weak.
Despite this, the firm maintains a positive rating due to reasonable valuation multiples and the company's leading business combination.
Sirius XM Holdings: Stock Price Driven by Spectrum Themes, Not Operational Improvements
Benchmark Equity Research maintained its "Buy" rating on Sirius XM Holdings but set a $30 target price below the current stock price.

The report notes that Sirius XM Holdings' recent stock price increase is driven by market attention to its spectrum monetization potential, rather than improved operational and strategic measures under CEO Jennifer Witz.
Analysts expect spectrum economics to be realized primarily through partnerships and new applications within the company, rather than another transformative TMT industry merger.

The report also notes that Sirius XM Holdings' core audio subscription business is less likely to experience a cliff-like decline compared to cable broadband, and its economic benefits are higher than many current video streaming services.
Caesars Entertainment: M&A Process Ongoing, Operating Evaluation Remains Neutral

Texas Capital Securities' latest report noted that Caesars Entertainment's second-quarter EBITDA was $4% lower than expected, mainly due to weaker-than-expected Las Vegas Strip and digital business performance.

The report also noted that Caesars Entertainment did not hold a conference call to discuss its second-quarter earnings and did not provide updates on its final acquisition agreement with Fertitta Entertainment.

Excluding the impact of lower-than-expected table games win rates, Las Vegas Strip EBITDA was $4% lower than market consensus, while digital business performance was in line with expectations after adjusting for win rates.
Regional business EBITDA was $7% higher than expected.
Despite lowering earnings estimates, Texas Capital Securities maintained a $31 target price, consistent with Fertitta Entertainment's $31 per share all-cash acquisition offer.
The firm noted that Caesars Entertainment's closing price of $29.84 on July 28 was still $3.4% below the acquisition price.
Considering the current M&A market environment and the pending transaction, the firm maintained a "Neutral" rating on the stock.

paras:
8/4 台股盤前要聞

1. 台股 3 日在亞股中一枝獨秀，終場收在 43,386 點，上漲 266 點，站穩 10 日線，不過，外資期現貨同步做空，大幅加碼空單超過 7,000 口，淨空單口數超過 9 萬口，創歷史新高；現貨也調節二線晶圓代工廠與面板雙虎，包括聯電、力積電、群創與友達，四檔合計賣超張數達 15 萬張。
2. 臺灣證券交易所 3 日下午召開臨時記者會，宣布修訂「公布注意暨處置有價證券相關規定」。為提升交易效率並維護市場秩序，自今 (2026) 年 8 月 10 日起，處置股票的「關禁閉」時間將大幅縮短，撮合頻率也由現行的 5 分鐘或 20 分鐘，統一加速至約每 2 分鐘撮合一次。此外，證交所同步放寬高價股的注意股票認定標準，並建立每半年定期檢視機制。
3. 台股 7 月如坐大怒神，歷經史上最大漲跌點洗禮後，投資人逢低買進態勢明確。統計最新台股 ETF 投資人數，市值雙雄元大台灣 50(0050-TW)、元大台灣 50 正 2(00631L-TW) 奪周增居冠、亞軍，0050 投資人數突破 350 萬，領先台積電來到近 50 萬，再創歷史新高。
4. 證交所 3 日宣布，8/10 起個股關禁閉縮短為 5 天 (當沖加重者 7 天)，並改採 2 分鐘撮合一次。市場關心，未來是否比照美、韓股市導入「熔斷機制」，證交所明確表態暫不考慮，主因台股已有 10% 漲跌幅限制及盤中瞬間價格穩定措施，足以提供冷卻效果並維護市場秩序。
5. 勞動基金公布今年上半年繳出亮眼成績單，截至 6 月底整體基金規模達到 8 兆 8,955 億元，收益數為 2 兆 2,024 億元，累積收益率高達 28.46%，再度刷新歷史最高紀錄。受惠於台股站上 4 萬 6 大關及 AI 科技需求強勁帶動，新制勞退基金平均每人分紅更來到 11.16 萬元，各項基金運用績效皆展現穩健成長。
6. 記憶體模組廠十銓 (4967-TW) 3 日公佈第二季財報，受惠 DRAM、NAND Flash 價格續漲，單季稅後淨利達 24.12 億元，季增 5.14%，年增 21827%，每股盈餘 26.47 元，續創歷史新高，累計上半年高達 53.44 元。

paras_en: On August 4, the Taiwan stock market was the only one to stand out among Asian stocks, closing at 43,386 points, up 266 points, and stabilizing above the 10-day line. However, foreign investors simultaneously short-sold stocks and futures, significantly increasing their short positions by over 7,000 contracts, with a net short position of over 90,000 contracts, a new historical high. In the spot market, they also adjusted their positions in second-line semiconductor foundries and panel makers, including UMC, Powerchip, Globalfoundries, and AU Optronics, with a total of 150,000 shares sold.

The Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE) held a press conference on August 3 to announce the revision of the 'Regulations for the Disclosure and Disposal of Securities'. To improve trading efficiency and maintain market order, starting from August 10, 2026, the 'suspension' period for disposing of stocks will be significantly shortened, and the matching frequency will be accelerated to every 2 minutes. Additionally, the TWSE will relax the standards for designating high-priced stocks and establish a semi-annual review mechanism.

In July, the Taiwan stock market experienced its largest ever fluctuation, but investors have been buying on dips. According to the latest statistics, the number of investors in the Taiwan 50 ETF (0050-TW) has surpassed 3.5 million, leading to a new historical high, with a lead of nearly 500,000 over TSMC.

The TWSE announced that starting from August 10, the suspension period for individual stocks will be shortened to 5 days (7 days for day traders), and the matching frequency will be changed to every 2 minutes. The market is concerned about whether the 'circuit breaker' mechanism will be introduced, similar to the US and Korean stock markets. The TWSE has stated that it will not consider this for the time being, as the Taiwan stock market already has a 10% fluctuation limit and instant price stabilization measures, which can provide a cooling effect and maintain market order.

The Labor Pension Fund has announced its impressive performance for the first half of the year, with a total fund size of NT$888.955 billion and a return of NT$202.024 billion, resulting in a cumulative return rate of 28.46%, a new historical high. Benefiting from the Taiwan stock market's rise above 46,000 and strong demand for AI technology, the average dividend per person for the new labor pension fund has reached NT$111,600, with all funds showing stable growth.

Memory module manufacturer Apacer (4967-TW) announced its second-quarter financial report, with a net profit of NT$2.412 billion, up 5.14% quarter-over-quarter and 21,827% year-over-year, and earnings per share of NT$26.47, a new historical high. The cumulative net profit for the first half of the year reached NT$5.344 billion.

items.title: 美股8月第一個交易日大漲 道瓊創歷史收盤新高 Amazon市值首破3兆美元
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Surge on First Trading Day of August, Dow Hits Record Closing High; Amazon Market Cap Breaks $3 Trillion
paras: 2026年08月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股8月首個交易日全面收高，道瓊工業指數創歷史收盤新高。市場預期美國與伊朗緊張局勢可望降溫，帶動油價與美國公債殖利率下滑，激勵投資人買盤回籠。
美國總統川普表示，美國與伊朗將就重新開放荷姆茲海峽展開談判，雖然伊朗否認將舉行會談，但市場仍期待衝突降溫。國際油價應聲重挫約5%，美國公債殖利率同步回落。不過，市場仍關注，若中東局勢再度升溫，恐再度推升通膨，增加聯準會升息壓力。
標普500指數11大類股中，通訊服務類股受Meta Platforms(META-US)與Alphabet(GOOGL-US)勁揚帶動，上漲逾4%，表現最佳；能源類股則因油價下跌而跌逾1%，表現最弱。
企業財報持續提供支持。根據統計，截至上週五，標普500已有304家公司公布財報，整體利潤年增率達29.3%，其中85.2%的企業每股盈餘優於市場預期。
亞馬遜Amazon(AMZN-US)延續財報利多，市值首度突破3兆美元。本週市場焦點將轉向AI概念股財報，包括Palantir(PLTR-US)、超微(AMD-US)、SanDisk(SNDK-US)及威騰電子Western Digital(WDC-US)。
另外，必治妥施貴寶Bristol Myers Squibb(BMY-US)傳出與阿斯特捷利康AstraZeneca(AZN-US)進行初步合併協商，股價變動不大；萬豪國際Marriott International(MAR-US)則因第三季獲利展望低於預期而下跌。
紐約聯邦準備銀行總裁John Williams表示，對通膨壓力逐步降溫抱持樂觀態度。市場目前預估，聯準會9月至少升息25個基點的機率為66.5%，本週五公布的美國非農就業報告將是後續觀察重點。
